Vintage Glass Telegraph & Telephone Insulators
Brookfield, Hemingray, Whitall Tatum
4 Items, Early to Mid-20th Century
This collection of four vintage glass utility insulators features classic examples produced for American telegraph, telephone, and power lines. The group includes two embossed Brookfield pieces in deep olive-green glass alongside clear embossed models from Hemingray and Whitall Tatum, showcasing iconic industrial molding details and drip point bases.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Brookfield Glass Insulator
- Brookfield, dark olive-green glass, embossed "BROOKFIELD" and "NEW YORK"
2.
Brookfield Glass Insulator
- Brookfield, dark green glass, embossed "BROOKFIELD" and "NEW YORK" with drip point rim
3.
Whitall Tatum Glass Insulator
- Whitall Tatum Co., clear glass, embossed "WHITALL TATUM CO. NO. 29"
4.
Hemingray Glass Insulator
- Hemingray, clear glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with drip point base
Condition:
Vintage condition consistent with historical outdoor utility service. The green glass insulators have chips along the base rims, and surface staining, residue, and weathering are present across all pieces. No through-cracks or structural failures.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland

285371207.description:
Large Assorted Mineral Rock Collection Smoky Quartz Amethyst Pyrite
Large assorted mineral and rock collection featuring multiple specimen types including smoky quartz, aragonite, peacock ore (bornite), amethyst, pyrite, obsidian, dendritic agate, and various other raw and tumbled stones. Collection includes compartmentalized plastic storage case with labeled mineral samples and additional clear storage container with diverse selection of rough and polished stones, crystals, and minerals. Obsidian pieces display glossy black appearance with conchoidal fracture characteristics. Other stones present variety of colors including purple, yellow, metallic, and earth tones. Condition is used but well-maintained with all pieces intact and organized. Suitable for collectors, educators, and hobbyists interested in mineralogy and geology.
Product Size:
11 x 7.5 x 6 in
